title: Adecco Group rolls out Agentforce Coworker to 27,000 staff in 40-plus countries
summary: Adecco Group, a major global staffing company, is deploying Salesforce's Agentforce Coworker AI assistant to 27,000 employees across more than 40 countries, following successful pilots in the UK and France. This large-scale rollout represents one of the most significant enterprise-wide implementations of agentic AI for workforce productivity.
problem_solved: Enables enterprises to deploy AI coworkers that handle daily workflow tasks across thousands of employees in multiple countries simultaneously.
why_valuable: This deployment serves as a landmark case study demonstrating that agentic AI is ready for large-scale enterprise adoption, potentially accelerating AI implementation across other Fortune 500 companies.
